Case ID: 1194
Case Type: IT Ticket
Date: 2025-04-09
Handled By: IT - Nina Cole
Customer or Requestor: Internal Employee - Seth Warren
Title: Admin dashboard access request exceeded role scope

Issue Description
An operations analyst requested access to an admin dashboard that exposed refund overrides and customer PII beyond the analyst's standard role requirements.

Steps Taken
- Reviewed the access request against the employee's job function and manager justification.
- Checked whether a lower-privilege reporting view could satisfy the stated business need.
- Consulted the data owner and Compliance regarding least-privilege expectations for the dashboard.
- Documented the review outcome and recommended access alternative in the ticket.

Resolution
Denied the elevated access request, granted access to a restricted reporting view instead, and recorded the decision as a least-privilege control action.

Follow-Up
IT and Compliance planned a review of role templates to reduce future overbroad access requests.

Reference Documents
- Access Control Runbook v2
- Information Security Policy Set
